attchmntText: Intense Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Intense Technologies Limited submitted copies of newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 11, 2026. Advertisements were published in Business Standard and Andhra Prabha on November 12, 2026. The company is Intense Technologies Limited, with scrip code 532326 and symbol INTENTECH. The registered office is in Hyderabad. The announcement also contains unrelated possession notices from IDFC FIRST Bank Limited and State Bank of India regarding immovable properties. Godavari Drugs Limited and TGV Group Limited also filed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. These filings are routine disclosures under SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: Intense Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Intense Technologies Limited has informed the exchange about press release for the Un-audited Financial results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Intense Technologies Limited filed a press release regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total income of 5,792.84 for the quarter and 6,689.37 for the half-year. EBITDA stood at 328.24 for the quarter and 856.64 for the half-year. Net profit was recorded at 222.70 for the quarter and 442.32 for the half-year. Earnings per share were 0.92 for the quarter and 1.80 for the half-year. The company added three new clients during the quarter, including two in the BFSI sector. An MoU was signed with MPCON LIMITED. The moderation in revenue for H1 FY2026-27 is attributed to the completion of high-value one-time projects in the previous period. The results are subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Intense Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Intense Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer
voiceSummary: Intense Technologies Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the resignation of Mrs. Pratyusha Podugu from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from November 11, 2026. Mrs. Podugu cited personal and professional reasons for her departure and confirmed there are no other material reasons. The Board also appointed Ms. Namrata K. Shaw as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from November 12, 2026. Ms. Shaw is an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India holding Membership Number A77634. The Board meeting commenced at 03:30 PM IST and concluded at 4:10 PM IST on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Intense Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Intense Technologies Limited approved unaudited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was 5,618.06 Lakhs, with a profit after tax of 222.70 Lakhs. The Board approved the resignation of Mrs. Pratyusha Podugu as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 11, 2026. Ms. Namrata K. Shaw was appointed as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 12, 2026. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report on the financial results. The Board meeting concluded at 4:10 PM on November 11, 2026.
